The '''Barab system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Albanin sector/Legends|Albanin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was known for containing [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabels]].
